mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as lower interest rates boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in consumer spending (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days due to expanded corporate investment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise when both GDPC1 and HOUST are increasing, despite other macro conditions being favorable.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 4% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as investors anticipate higher interest rates reducing corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4%, or the rate increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 5% and INDPRO rising), a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate earnings growth outpaces inflation concerns.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises in the regime but 60-day returns do not follow, or UNRATE exceeds 5% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days as investors anticipate lower inflation and potential rate cuts.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not rise when CPIAUCSL is declining, or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and consumer demand (GDPC1) over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 returns in the next 60 days due to expanded corporate revenue and consumer spending.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not follow when both PAYEMS and GDPC1 are increasing, despite other indicators being stable.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as investors anticipate weaker labor market conditions and reduced corporate hiring.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 5%, or the rate increase is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-side recovery regime (INDPRO rising and GDPC1 also rising), a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as corporate investment in manufacturing accelerates.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises in the regime but 20-day returns do not follow, or GDPC1 does not rise concurrently.
